assessment: The authors explored the time-dependent effects of inhibition of parvalbumin-expressing interneurons (PV cells) in the mouse prefrontal cortex on task learning and cognition. Overall, the important study provides solid evidence showing that prefrontal cortex PV cell activity during a sensitive period of neurodevelopment affects prefrontal cortex function in the adult mouse. This study progresses our understanding of the development of the prefrontal cortex.
